blurb: Guests can explore Alcatraz Island with audio-guided tours and ranger programs, enjoy scenic ferry rides, and choose between day and night tours. The operator also offers a 5-hour seaplane and Muir Woods adventure including hotel pickup and a 30-minute scenic flight. Additionally, a 2-day private tour package to Redwood National Park includes guided visits to giant redwoods, coastal views, and accommodations.
